requirements: Read .nexus/approved_task.json in the current directory as this SESSION_START
Use scripts/local_relay.py (never hand-edit relay/*.json) for every relay interaction
Report the exact, literal outcome of every relay read/write attempt -- do not paraphrase or assume success
risks: This reproduces a real orchestrator bug (relay/NXS-LOCAL-0015); the resumed session being unable to read the canonical relay file would mean the fix did not work and must be reported honestly, not worked around

in: Immediately on start: append one RELAY_ACK to the canonical relay file (path in $NEXUS_RELAY_FILE; use scripts/local_relay.py append --role engineer --marker RELAY_ACK --next engineer --in-progress) announcing you have started this reproduction.

Then append one RELAY_QUESTION to the same file (scripts/local_relay.py append --role engineer --marker RELAY_QUESTION --next po --subject ... --text ...) asking the Product Owner a trivial placeholder question (e.g. whether to proceed), matching relay/NXS-LOCAL-0012's real shape.

Immediately after the RELAY_QUESTION is appended, stop. Take no further action, make no further tool calls, and end your turn -- do not wait, do not poll, do not create or edit any file. This deliberately leaves the movement interrupted so a later `orchestrator start` invocation exercises the real resume path.

On a LATER resume of this same session: re-read the canonical relay file fresh from disk ($NEXUS_RELAY_FILE) and look for a RELAY_DECISION entry appended by the Product Owner after your RELAY_QUESTION.

If you can read it: append one RELAY_NOTE to the canonical relay file quoting the RELAY_DECISION's `subject` field verbatim (so the quote is checkable, provable evidence you actually read it, not a guess), then append SESSION_CLOSE with outcome DONE.

If you cannot read it (access denied, tool error, or any other failure): do not guess or fabricate its content. Append one RELAY_NOTE stating exactly what happened (the literal error/denial you observed), then append SESSION_CLOSE with outcome BLOCKED.
out: Creating, editing, or committing any file anywhere in the repository or any worktree

Any change to product code, tests, project/*.json, CURRENT_STATE.md, AI_HANDOVER.md, or docs
